relationships.subject: Endometriosis
relationships.evidence_quote: EM patients presented more NOP-positive nerve fibers (mean ± SD: 1.22 ± 1.62 NOP-positive NF/mm2) when compared with controls

relationships.subject: NOP receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: many (50–75%) sensory fibers (SP- and CGRP-positive) in the EM and control samples were co-labeled with an antibody for NOP receptor

key_findings: NOP receptor-positive nerve fibers and vessels are increased in peritoneal endometriosis and colocalize with SP, CGRP, TH and VIP fibers.
NOP expression correlated with rASRM stage but not pain levels.
